title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 28081 Marguerite Parkway in Mission Viejo, California, as the "Major Megan McClung Post Office Building".
official_summary: This act designates the facility of the U.S. Postal Service located at 28081 Marguerite Parkway in Mission Viejo, California, as the Major Megan McClung Post Office Building.

summary.headline: Congress named a Mission Viejo, California post office building after Major Megan McClung.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 28081 Marguerite Parkway in Mission Viejo, California, as the Major Megan McClung Post Office Building. It is a naming measure only and does not change postal services, rules, or funding. The official summary describes only the designation itself.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on November 25, 2024, and the designation took effect on that date.
